title: 第十二章 热水-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    而这份无处发泄的愤怒，也不可避免地被牵连到了爻雪的身上。

    苏辰察觉到自己队友的想法，说道：“她说，她是站在我们这一边的。”

    最先冷静下来的是小六，他对着众人说道：“这种能够将一个拥有完整文明的星球改造成末世游戏的存在，普通人肯定无法改变它的想法。”

    言下之意，爻雪也是无辜的，他们不应该迁怒对方。

    “对了队长，你刚刚不是说除了觉醒药剂一百枚晶核一支还有另外一个任务，收集一千枚晶核，那这两个任务能够一起完成吗？”

    ……

    “当然不可以，想什么好事呢。”爻雪白了一眼过来问问题的小六说道。

    听罢，小六一脸失望地回去了，这时，七人中长相最斯文的青年缓步走了过来，脸上露出了温和的表情，说道：“店长，队长已经将你之前的话跟我们说了，我们也知道你开这个店是迫不得已，但既然我们是站在同一条战线上的，那你是不是应该给我们多提供一些便利呢。”

    闻言，爻雪面带微笑地看着面前这个人，说道：“不行，一些消息只有等时间到了才能告诉你们。”

    这话当然是骗人的，毕竟她说是本次末世游戏的NPC，但实际上，她除了一个系统之外，简直可以说是白手起家了，地是自己的，建筑用的材料是自己的，商店里面购买的东西也是自己的，甚至就连升级材料也需要自己去收集，后续的一些产品更是需要她自己去制作。

    如果命苦是一种天赋的话，那她一定是天赋异禀。

    “不过，你说的对，我们是站在同一条战线上的，你们强大，对我才有好处。”毕竟她还等着这些人帮自己去探索秘境呢。

    “所以我这里确实有一个消息，免费送给你们，五天之后，血雨会再次降临，那些被血雨变异的怪物在再次淋雨之后会得到强化。”

    听到爻雪的话，青年脸上的笑容瞬间消失，表情变得严肃无比，“多谢提醒。”

Page (1/3)

And this anger that had nowhere to vent was inevitably implicated in Yaoxue.

Su Chen noticed what his teammate was thinking and said, "She said she is on our side."

The first person to calm down was Xiaoliu. He said to everyone: "This kind of existence can transform a planet with complete civilization into an apocalyptic game. Ordinary people will definitely not be able to change its mind."

The implication is that Yaoxue is also innocent, and they should not vent their anger on each other.

"By the way, captain, didn't you just say that in addition to the awakening potion with one hundred crystal nuclei, there is another task, which is to collect one thousand crystal nuclei. Can these two tasks be completed together?"

……

"Of course not, why are you thinking of something good?" Yao Xue said with a white look at Xiao Liu who came over to ask a question.

After hearing this, Xiao Liu went back with a disappointed look on his face. At this time, the most polite-looking young man among the seven walked over slowly, with a gentle expression on his face, and said: "Store manager, the captain has told us what you said before. We also know that you have no choice but to open this store, but since we are on the same front, shouldn't you provide us with more conveniences?"

Hearing this, Yaoxue looked at the person in front of her with a smile and said, "No, I can't tell you some news until the time comes."

This is of course a lie. After all, she said she was an NPC in this apocalyptic game, but in fact, except for one system, she can be said to have started from scratch. The land is her own, the materials used for construction are her own, and the things purchased in the store are also her own. Even the upgrade materials need to be collected by herself, and some subsequent products need to be made by herself.

If suffering a miserable life is a kind of talent, then she must be gifted.

"However, you are right, we are on the same front. It is good for me if you are strong." After all, she is still waiting for these people to help her explore the secret realm.

"So I do have a piece of news here, which I will give to you for free. In five days, the blood rain will come again, and the monsters mutated by the blood rain will be strengthened after being exposed to the rain again."

Hearing Yaoxue's words, the smile on the young man's face disappeared instantly, and his expression became extremely serious, "Thanks for the reminder."
